All tests pass. The fix adds an early return for `None` values in `resolve_lookup_value`, preventing the subsequent `resolve_expression` call from being attempted on a null value when annotations are chained with `values()` and `filter()`.

The patch is minimal and targeted — it only affects the specific code path where `None` would otherwise trigger the AttributeError, without changing behaviour for any other value types.
